decision: Make the existing Control Plane fail-closed against current stored Control Cards even when their filenames are arbitrary.
why_now: Compatibility audit found the live card E3_CONTROL_CARD.json through workflow references rather than the earlier filename search, showing that explicit per-file check invocation alone is insufficient for a global default rule.
contract: Discover Control Card-shaped JSON by schema/content signature, not by filename.
Validate current stored cards with the existing control_plane.validate_card implementation.
Exclude explicit replay/example/test/receipt/archive/legacy provenance zones from prospective migration enforcement.
Run the scan on every pull request and every push to main through the existing AI Governance workflow.
Do not create a new Gate or a second Control Card registry.
Do not encode any fixed project chapter count.
does_not_prove: Repository scan PASS is not Design PASS or MAIN status.
It does not upgrade Field, Rights, Engineering, Human, Promotion or Release state.
It does not rewrite historical provenance.
